name: suede-referrals
description: Suede AI referral and affiliate program design: refer a friend and ambassador mechanics, incentive sizing from LTV and margin, affiliate commission structures, payout logic, fraud controls, attribution, FTC endorsement disclosure and incentivized-review rules, and viral loop measurement (K-factor, cohort LTV of referred customers). Returns a program spec with economics, rules, tooling options, and a launch checklist. Use when designing refer-a-friend mechanics, ambassador or partner incentives,
author: JasonColapietro
